name: gospel-of-john-city
description: The Gospel of John rendered as a city — 2D map + 3D ancient city

scripts.verify: node scripts/verify_parity.mjs && node scripts/verify_chiasms.mjs && node scripts/verify_themes.mjs
scripts.smoke: node scripts/smoke2d.mjs index.html && node scripts/smoke.mjs city3d-three.html && node scripts/smoke.mjs city3d.html
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:three && npm run bundle:chiasm
scripts.build: npm run verify && npm run bundle && python3 scripts/build.py
